operation.summary: The newest image of a type; with since and wait, waits for the next one

query.name: since
query.description: ISO time or gallery id: only an image added after it

query.name: wait
query.description: With since: hold up to this many seconds (max 55) for a new image

query.name: size
query.description: Preset: agent (1568 px, q85), thumb (512, q75), large (2560, q90), original

query.name: max_edge_px
query.description: Long edge limit, 64-20000; overrides the preset

query.name: raw
query.description: 1 = return the image bytes, details in X-Bridgit-* headers

operation.returns: id, type, taken_at, added_at, album, width_px, height_px, size_bytes, data_base64
